prompt_fragment: This asset is a card face. Compose for a vertical 3:4 frame with a strong focal subject and room for card framing or overlay treatment.
raw_description:
Upper half: a Wake-Singer mid-ritual over the Corpse Current. She sings
into the deep; the water around her visibly distorts from invoked
pressure-magic. Warm copper-scented current rising from below; the faint
outline of something vast and two-miles-long in the abyssal shadow
beneath her — the dead god. Lower half: warm dark surface for text,
ghosted silhouette watermark. Warm cream parchment frame.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor naturalist plate, a ritual-scarred orca wake-singer suspended vertically in abyssal water over a copper-tinged Corpse Current, ivory scar-lines luminous against blue-black hide, warm vellum cream framing the archival composition.

subjects.description: Adult orca oriented vertically, narrow snout latticed with hunt-liturgy scars, resonance-chambers carved into flanks, salt-crust texture across hide, open jaw mid-liturgy song, pressure-depth haze warping surrounding water into dense gravitational rings
subjects.position: upper half, centered, facing downward into the deep

subjects.description: Warm copper-tinted water column rising from below, water visibly distorting in subsonic concentric pulls; two-mile ghosted silhouette of the dead god in abyssal slate shadow, vast and barely resolved, dissolved into the deep
subjects.position: full vertical center, deepening from mid-frame to lower edge

subjects.description: Aged vellum border with faint foxing at corners, warm cream surface at lower third forming a text-ready panel, ghosted orca silhouette watermark faint beneath
subjects.position: full frame border and lower third
